# `company.credit_source_keys`

Permanent credit source ownership; never reassigned after the credit is issued.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with transaction_id + id | ix_credit_source_keys_party | — | Permanent exact-party credit identity; an application names this, never a revision. |
